items.name: USNI News Western Pacific Pulse: Nov. 13, 2026
items.summary: The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week. In Singapore The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group departed on Sunday from Singapore. The strike group includes aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) with embarked carrier air wing (CVW) 11, cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65) and destroyers USS Paul Hamilton (DDG-60) and USS Decatur (DDG-73). Theodore Roosevelt, Chosin and Decatur sailed west to enter the Malacca Strait while Paul Hamilton sailed east into the South China Sea. Theodore Roosevelt, Chosin and Decatur are now in the Indian Ocean en route to U.S.
